title: Immediate flip failure could advance the sequence twice
summary: For steps not waiting on the imager, flip_failed called failure() at once; an advance timer not stored in wait_for_timer (0 s step completion, pause polling, altitude completion) or a step waiting on the device whose Alert failed the flip could cause a second execute_next. Next: defer the failure to the end of the step unless a cancellable step timer runs.

resolution.evidence: flip_failed fails at once only after cancelling a step timer, otherwise stores flip_failure applied by failure() or execute_next once; suite 44/44; verification.md.
